data.title: 圣路易斯 · 白鹰指挥室的制服小憩
data.description: 白鹰舰队指挥室内，窗外阳光明亮。圣路易斯身穿合身修剪的白鹰海军制服短裙，解开制服外套领口，端坐在宽大办公桌边。冰蓝长发随性垂在肩前，单手托着下巴，紫色美眸中含着宠溺与理解的笑意，注视着伏案工作的指挥官，尽显完美秘书兼贴心恋人的无穷魅力。
data.action: perched on edge of office desk in naval officer uniform, loosened tie and open collar, holding paperwork tablet, doting radiant smile looking at viewer
data.location: grand maritime command office with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking naval harbor
data.lighting: bright clear daylight streaming through harbor-facing office windows
data.mood: capable professional elegance, comforting affectionate support
data.promptProse: Perched on the edge of a naval command desk in her crisp white Eagle Union uniform, St. Louis relaxes with an open collar. Sunlight floods the harbor outside as she gazes forward with supportive, radiant affection.
data.animaCaption: St. Louis sitting on a naval office desk in her uniform with an open collar, smiling radiantly.
